findings.description: The cube the hand is turning starts solid green with a '2' (00:00.00), becomes half green/half blue at 00:00.50 and is fully blue by 00:00.75. A plastic cube cannot change colour by being rotated; it is a morph, not a different face.

A second blue cube with a '3' grows out of the side of the held blue cube at 00:01.00-00:01.25 and settles between it and the green '2'. The hand never picks up a new cube, so the cube appears from nowhere.

findings.entity: green cube (slot 3) and new green '3' cube
findings.description: The static green '2' cube shows a '3' on its front at 00:02.50-00:02.75 without being turned to a new face, then goes back to '2' at 00:03.25 while a separate green '3' cube splits off its right side. One cube becomes two.
The green '3' cube in the hand at 00:03.50 has become a beige/orange '2' cube by 00:03.75. Colour and number both change in 0.25 s with no visible flip.
A blue '3' cube appears at the hand at 00:04.00 with no source, then turns pale white/grey by 00:04.75.

findings.invariant_violated: object spawning, colour and number permanence
findings.description: Another blue '3' cube materialises at 00:05.00-00:05.25. It turns green by 00:05.75, and at 00:06.00 its front face reads '5' while a new green '3' cube splits off beside it.
The green '3' cube at 00:06.50 reads '2' by 00:06.75 while a blue '3' cube appears next to it from nowhere. That blue '3' then reads '6' at 00:07.75 without a visible rotation.

The clip starts with two cubes on an otherwise empty table and ends with eight in a row. No cubes are brought in from off-frame and the hand never carries more than the cube it is touching, so the cube count grows on its own.
